name: inspira-dither-shader
title: Dither Shader
blurb: Canvas-rendered images with dithering patterns and color quantization.
description: Canvas component applying ordered dithering (bayer, halftone, noise, crosshatch) and color reduction to images. Supports brightness, contrast, palette modes, and frame animation.
use_when: Artistic image effects for galleries, retro aesthetics, or stylized presentations.
avoid_when: Real-time video or high-volume galleries — canvas processing has per-frame CPU cost.
a11y: Canvas-rendered with aria-label and role=img. Image source is loaded but not directly exposed to screen readers.
